name: resalemasterlab

scripts.build: node scripts/validate-vinext-entry.mjs && vinext build && node scripts/prepare-static-build.mjs
scripts.build:verified: npm run build && npm run validate:artifact
scripts.build:windows: node scripts/validate-vinext-entry.mjs && vinext build && node scripts/prepare-static-build.mjs
scripts.test:full: npm run lint && npm run build:verified && npm test
scripts.preview:cloudflare: npm run build && npx wrangler@latest dev
scripts.deploy:static: npm run build:static && npm run validate:static && npx wrangler@latest deploy
scripts.build:static: node scripts/validate-vinext-entry.mjs && vinext build && node scripts/prepare-static-build.mjs --require-static

description: ResaleMasterLab marketplace research, listing monitoring, and local AI analysis.
